name: Spivey Cove Campground
note: Small primitive Cherokee NF campground on a loop at the end of Spivey Creek Rd, a short side road off Tellico River Rd (FR 210) about 12 miles above Tellico Plains, in a hollow back from the Tellico River. The Forest Service gives no rig length and no camper report confirms a 23-ft rig fits, so pad size is unconfirmed. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/spivey-cove-campground (read 2026-11-25, page updated 2025-03-20): its own FS page in the Tellico River region, separate from North River 4419 - 'Looking for a quiet campground tucked back into a hollow near Tellico River? Try this campground offering 16 sites.', 'Single Site: $6 per night / Fee is $6 per site (16 sites)', 'Seasons of Use 5/21/2024 - 11/19/2024', vault toilet, no potable water; the 'Site Closed' banner on 2026-11-25 (and in the 2026-04-05 Wayback capture) falls outside that season. rec.gov facility 10158862 active (is_deactivated false), 'first-come, first-served basis only', Scan & Pay. The Dyrt lists Drive-In / 'Park next to your site', tent and RV sites; Google Maps 5.0 / 6 reviews, recent ones ('a year ago', i.e. ~2025) describe camping there ('everyone loved the sites we used ... no electric or water hook ups'). Leaf-off Esri Wayback (2016-03-29) shows an access road and a gravel loop with spurs at ~35.3035-35.3045,-84.1131/-84.1140. No rig length stated anywhere -> kept as an unclear-pad-size entry with a caveat (AWH 2026-11-02). Public, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-25: current Esri World_Imagery (hw 220 m and 600 m, rendered) is leaf-on canopy with only a gravel track and one small clearing visible; Esri Wayback 2016-03-29 leaf-off z18 (rendered) shows the access road entering from the SW and a gravel loop with spurs in the hollow, the stream itself not visible. Spivey Creek is a small creek (well under 30 m wide - creekside at most); the Tellico River is ~600 m W across River Rd. 3DEP (epqs.nationalmap.gov) NW-SE transect through the loop: loop 581-582 m, valley floor 579.5 m ~50 m NW, so the creek runs somewhere along the hollow floor near the loop, but no pad can be placed against it. No per-site map, no rec.gov per-site tags (one placeholder 'Standard' site), no site photos; a ~2025 Google review says 'its only downside was it wasn't on the river', another 'not far from the river'. No qualifying source names pads at the water -> default down to not waterfront. Lead: creekside if dated site photos show pads at Spivey Creek with an easy walk down.

fees.note: $6 a site a night; at most 5 people and 2 vehicles a site. Pay on site (Recreation.gov Scan & Pay).

fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/spivey-cove-campground ('Single Site: $6 per night'; 'Fee is $6 per site (16 sites)'; 'Maximum of 5 people and 2 vehicles at each site.'), read 2026-11-25; Scan & Pay from rec.gov 10158862 overview, read 2026-11-25
booking_source: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10158862 via the public facility API ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.'), read 2026-11-25
sites_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/spivey-cove-campground ('Try this campground offering 16 sites.'; 'Fee is $6 per site (16 sites)'), read 2026-11-25; Campflare and Hipcamp also say 16
facilities_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/spivey-cove-campground ('Restrooms: Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-11-25
season_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/spivey-cove-campground ('Seasons of Use 5/21/2024 - 11/19/2024' - the FS has not posted 2025/2026 dates; 'Site Closed' banner on 2026-11-25, after the 11-19 close), read 2026-11-25; corroborated by campflare.com/campground/10158862 ('Currently closed for the season'; 'opens around late May and closes mid-November'), read 2026-11-25
flags: SEPARATE from 4419 North River: its own FS page (16 sites at $6, seasonal) vs North River's (11 sites at $8, year-round, FS point 35.3181,-84.1257 on North River Rd FR 217); its own rec.gov facility (10158862 vs 10158793); on Esri topo it sits in the Spivey Creek hollow at the end of Spivey Creek Rd off Tellico River Rd, about 2 km SE of North River in a different valley.

Status: FS page shows 'Site Closed' on 2026-11-25 and in the only Wayback capture (2026-04-05); both dates fall outside its posted 5/21-11/19 season, and Campflare calls it closed for the season. No FS alert names Spivey Cove or Tellico River Rd (only Citico Creek in this district). Recent Google reviews (~2025) describe stays. Taken as seasonally closed, not closed long-term - reviewer may want a 2026 in-season confirmation.
Season dates are the FS's 2024 'Seasons of Use' (5/21-11/19); no 2025/2026 dates are posted.

Pin: FS page and rec.gov point 35.3039,-84.1131 sit on the east end of the loop; moved ~45 m W to the loop centre 35.30385,-84.11360 (leaf-off Wayback 2016). Google Maps 35.30341,-84.11602 (5.0 / 6) is ~220 m WSW on the access road - not used. Elevation 581 m from 3DEP at the loop.

Hookups group omitted: primitive sites, no potable water, a Google review says 'no electric or water hook ups', but no agency source states electric/water/sewer and the rec.gov catalog is one placeholder 'Standard' NONELECTRIC site (too small to read electric 0 from). The Dyrt's 'sanitary dump' line is unsupported by the FS page - dump omitted.
Unclear pad size: no FS length, no camper RV-size report (The Dyrt reviews 2019-2020 say nothing on rig size) - kept with a caveat in the note.
Phone is the Tellico Ranger District office (423-397-8455, as on Birch Branch 15768 / Holder Cove 15770 / North River 4419); Campendium lists the older 423-253-8400; rec.gov lists none.
No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Smokies 53 km) - irrelevant for a federal campground. RV Life rating not looked up (public campground).
